ui: v2rayNG-style per-app enable/bypass switches, app icon/name/package checkboxes, search, select/invert and system-app filter; source attribution included.
material: Transparent system bars and header; explicit radius20 background sampling, low-alpha tint and floating navigation with rim and shadow.
background: Supervise owned OS VPN channel separately from native core state. Confirmed absence triggers TUN/core rebuild; known stopped core triggers repair. Unknown inventory and node latency failures never prove VPN loss. Bounded 5/15/60s backoff, three attempts per120s window. Foreground orphan recovery requires >30s stale matching session, absent bearer, existing cleanup protocol and locked CAS. No claim of resurrecting a fully killed process in background.
validation_limit: 194 related Node tests passed. Official 1.14.4 CLI validates IPv6 on/off runtime configurations. Both unsigned Release variants compile. Native tests are unchanged from the verified 1.14.4 build. 0.2.11 was observed running on phone with traffic; 0.2.12 has no signed device installation validation or packet/energy verification.
startup_change: Encrypted candidate files use complete fd writes, fsync, close and authenticated read-back before promotion. First-tap phone regression remains unverified.
application_catalog: Real bundle.getAllApplicationInfo behind GET_BUNDLE_INFO_PRIVILEGED check. Normal signing remains blocked; requires-acl HAP declares permission but still needs an approved signing profile. No successful on-phone enumeration claim.
network_change: Physical Wi-Fi/cellular events debounce 200ms and retry at 1200ms. SSID exclusion takes priority; resume waits for validated underlay. Changed physical signature invokes core ResetNetwork without rebuilding TUN.
persistence: Successful manual selector/mode commands are saved by the VPN Extension to a per-profile encrypted persistent choice catalog outside disposable runtime storage. Initial and resumed launches apply saved defaults before core validation/start. UI card visibility/group expansion/log filter/system app visibility use stable preferences. No raw profile JSON rewrite. Same signing identity and preserved application data required for in-place upgrades.
privacy: Always capture both IP families; optional IPv6 rejection is inside TUN before mode rules. STUN in rule/global modes is sniffed and routed through selected proxy; direct mode/SSID suspension/excluded apps remain direct. Port53 is hijacked for captured traffic only when DNS servers exist. Browser local host candidates and total OS process removal cannot be hidden/prevented by this implementation.
dashboard_modes: Deduplicate case aliases and display Direct, Rule, Global in that order. Privacy adaptation retains configured mode values without introducing upper/lowercase aliases.
